title: nwjl.1: C: extend slot-claim signature transcript to cover slots array
description: coap_slot_coord.c:316-337 signs only ordinal/IID/superframe_id. The slots array is not covered, allowing signature-valid forgeries with attacker-chosen slots. Fix: include the slots array in the canonical transcript before signing. This is the critical security fix — can land independently of the full COSE_Sign1 migration (l1qw.16.4). Must update both signer and verifier. Add test with tampered slots array.
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (store write lost — bd8h) + audit: already implemented by the landed COSE_Sign1 migration. claim_encode_payload (coap_slot_coord.c:833-865) signs integer keys 1-7 INCLUDING CLAIM_KEY_SLOTS with the full slots array; the verifier digests that same cose_payload (claim_compute_digest :388 -> schnorr48_verify :397) so a tampered slots array fails LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_INVALID_SIG. No code change needed.
